pkg.headline: MPs call for better access and long-term weight-loss support
pkg.standfirst: A parliamentary report calls for clearer access and continuing support. These recommendations do not change NHS eligibility.
pkg.article_markdown:
MPs want obesity care in England redesigned around a long-term condition, with clearer treatment pathways and fairer access. Their report was published on 23 October 2026.

The Health and Social Care Committee calls for continuing nutritional, behavioural and mental-health support. It also sees a possible role for private digital providers, supported by better data sharing.

The report flags weight-loss tablets when questioning whether regulators can keep pace with illegal sales. It does not announce a tablet approval, change NHS eligibility or confirm new funding. These are recommendations to government.

[Read the full parliamentary report](https://publications.parliament.uk/pa/cm5902/cmselect/cmhealth/518/report.html).
pkg.shift_take: For tablet users, care and follow-up matter alongside the prescription.
unknowns: Government response and implementation remain to be established.
